details: Dispatch road maintenance truck with hot asphalt compound. Fill center lane pothole at NH-44 coordinate (13.0358, 77.5978). Use mechanical rolling compactors. Divert middle lane traffic during compaction.
Replace 120W LED luminaire bulb on pole #E32, ITPL main road junction. Run diagnostic check on wiring conduit for line leakage.

Clogged drainage inlet near St. John's hospital coordinates (12.9344, 77.6206) causing street flooding. Dispatch suction/hydro-jetting vehicle. Clean out concrete debris and silt. Replace damaged gully grate.
